headline: Midwest grocer expands micro-fulfillment centers

headline: Direct-to-consumer brands double down on wholesale

headline: Grocery chains test AI-powered loss prevention
summary: Several U.S. grocery banners are piloting computer vision platforms to curb shrink while maintaining a low-friction experience.

summary: Mall operators are using art installations and limited-time drops to bring Gen Z shoppers into suburban centers.

headline: Beauty retailers lean on same-day delivery partners

headline: Luxury resale platforms add authentication lounges
